name: cavemio-activity-rings
title: Activity rings
description: Three daily goals as concentric rings beside a tight legend, with the week underneath: pick a day and the rings sweep to it.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The legend is real text: each goal’s figure, target and share, so the rings never carry meaning on their own.
- The week is a radio group: arrow keys, Home and End move between days with data, and each day’s name and shares are its label.
- Colours are --chart-1 to --chart-3 from your theme; each ring’s track is a light step of its own colour.
- It sizes to its own width: below about 450px the rings, type and spacing step down.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the rings are simply filled.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Fitness and health apps
useCases.description: Daily move, exercise and stand-style goals, with the week underneath.

useCases.title: Habit and goal trackers
useCases.description: Three goals for today, and a way to look back at earlier days.

useCases.title: Learning apps
useCases.description: Daily minutes, lessons and practice goals for students.

useCases.title: Team dashboards
useCases.description: Three daily targets, such as calls, demos and replies, against what a person or team has done.

features.title: Three goals, three rings
features.description: Outermost first, each in its own colour from your theme, with the figures rolling up as they arrive.

features.title: A legend in real text
features.description: Each goal’s figure, target and share is written out, so the rings never carry the meaning alone.

features.title: Going past 100%
features.description: A goal that is beaten carries on round for a second lap, with a dot marking how far it got.

features.title: Look back at any day
features.description: The week sits underneath as seven small rings; pick one and the big rings sweep to that day.

features.title: Days to come stay quiet
features.description: Days without data are dimmed and can’t be picked.

features.title: Fits its space
features.description: It sizes to its own width, steps down on narrow cards, and the days work with arrow keys.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each ring sweeps from the top (1100ms, 120ms apart, outer first), the week’s small rings follow 40ms apart, and every figure rolls up from zero.

states.title: day
states.description: Picking a day sweeps the big rings to its shares, morphs the title to its name and rolls the figures. Days after the last one with data are dimmed and aria-disabled.

states.title: past
states.description: Over 100%, a second lap draws over the first and a dot ringed in the surface colour marks its lead, fading in as the lap lands.

states.title: focus
states.description: Pointing at a ring’s row dims the other rings to 30% and the other rows to 45%.
